claims.assertion: Anéeka says tractor-beam portals target a room by mapping its location and frequency; each shipboard unit is a three-meter sphere using several gigawatts.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says opening one creates a detectable magnetic-energy node.

claims.assertion: Anéeka describes portal machinery as a computer-controlled electromagnetic toroid that shifts matter to a destination frequency.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: A complete room-to-room bridge uses about 150 gigawatts.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says hyperspace travel is technically time travel for frequency-manipulating interstellar ships.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says ethical risks require training and reserve it for elite Sand Clock squadrons.
